<!-- Generated by tools/cli-reference.py from `backdown token --help`. Edit the help in crates/backdown-cli (or the notes in the script) and run it again. -->


```text
backdown token [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

`--links`
: Print only the links, one per line.

`--qr`
: Show the link for other devices as a QR code, for the BackDown phone app to scan.

Also takes the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.
